name: 29486 · Summerville, SC
findings: ZIP 29486 (Summerville) has 54 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 29486 (Summerville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 29486 (Summerville) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 32% of the typical level).
